newsitem.title: USA: Dense-Pac sees profits in 1997 second half.
newsitem.headline: Dense-Pac sees profits in 1997 second half.

text.p: Dense-Pac Microsystems Inc said Wednesday it expects to be profitable in the second half of fiscal 1997.
"At this time, I am encouraged by our initial receipt of order for SuperSIMM memory modules announced earlier this month for shipment over the next 12 months," Dense-Pac chief executive James Turner.
For the first half of the year, Dense-Pac reported a net loss of $227,000 or $0.01 a share on sales of $7.7 million, compared with net income of $725,000 or $0.05 a share on sales of $8.6 million.
First-half results included inventory writedowns of $570,000 due to rapidly declining memory chip prices, the company said.
Dense-Pac manufactures chip-stacking technologies that allow companies to pack huge amounts of memory into small spaces.
